title: Drive, not build: Flow-Lenia gliders whose matter is exactly conserved but whose growth-field gain is set by a consumed, regrowing food hold together only while they eat; removing the food disperses every glider within ~75 t (2/2 seeds) while fed twins glide on
summary: world.py = fl_forager with its build-from-food metabolism replaced: no matter is made or destroyed (drift 2e-11 over 400 t); food phi is consumed where matter is (0.02 phi A_sum per step) and regrows toward 1 (0.01 per step), and the growth field U is multiplied by phi/(phi+0.3). From one noise patch 2-3 crescent gliders form and travel, leaving faint food trails (d_k05.png, k_cons 0.05). At a fork at t=200 (dfork.py), setting food and its regrowth to 0 drops the gliders' peak density from ~2.3 to 0.3 in 25 t and leaves 0 bodies from t=275 on seeds 0 and 1, the matter spreading as a faint film; the fed twins keep 2-3 gliders to t=500 (dfork_s0.png, dfork_s1.png). This is a first world for C:metabolic-cell where body matter is not built from the resource. Limits: the food scales the whole interaction (close to switching the growth field off rather than starving a pathway), bodies do not grow so they do not divide, no local per-body fork yet, 2 seeds of one fork.
